articles.headline: Didier Deschamps to rejoin France after mom's funeral
articles.description: FOXBOROUGH, Mass. -- Didier Deschamps will fly back to Boston on Saturday and be reunited with the France squad after missing the 4-1 win against Norway on Friday to attend the funeral of his mother.

articles.headline: Kylian Mbappe at the World Cup: History, results, stats
articles.description: As Mbappé aims to lead France back to soccer's mountaintop, here is a look at his career at the FIFA World Cup.

articles.headline: Reece James to miss England vs Panama with injury, Declan Rice, Elliot Anderson fit
articles.description: Thomas Tuchel has confirmed Reece James will miss Saturday's Group L finale against Panama but Elliot Anderson and Declan Rice are available to start.

articles.headline: Norway coach Stale Solbakken: Resting Haaland vs. France a 'no-brainer'
articles.description: Norway coach Stale Solbakken said his decision to rest ten first-team players including Erling Haaland against France was a "no-brainer" due to medical tests showing fatigue affecting several members of his squad.

articles.headline: Five-star Senegal make the most of last-gasp chance to reach FIFA World Cup knockouts
articles.description: While the jury's still out on this expanded 48-team FIFA World Cup, Senegal won't be complaining after thumping Iraq 5-0 to keep their hopes of reaching the knockout stages alive in their final Group I game.
